nodes.label: Q2: Inside Success rollout
nodes.explain: Decision 0011 paused the Inside Success team rollout until whygame5 produced a result under AES; that condition was met on 2026-09-26 and the call to resume was never made. The one-tool design says any repository, personal or Inside Success, installs Lockstep with one command; slice 6 merged on 2026-11-12 and Team-Brains' Project Brain runner, an Inside Success repository, now vendors Lockstep's wheel (Team-Brains#1183, wiki/lockstep.md:22). Close the old rollout item, or keep it open? Recommendation: Close decision 0011 item 4: the rollout it paused was of the v0.2 `aes` command line, which now retires. Putting Lockstep into Inside Success repositories is slice 6 of the one-tool plan and would come to you then as its own decision. Default: The rollout stays paused and decision 0011 item 4 stays as written. Team-Brains' runner already vendors the wheel, so the call to keep that and to close or keep item 4 is now to be made about work that has shipped.

nodes.label: Q17: Not in the code2 repository format
nodes.explain: ~/code2/AGENTS.md brings each repository into the code2 format when it is next changed; scripts/repo_format.py reports this one 0 of 1 compliant (missing docs/index.md, arc42, a .c4 model, a Makefile that mentions code2check). The one-tool build changes this repository, and its slice 6 replaces code2check with lockstep in the code2 template. Adopt the format now, or in slice 6? Settled by: An argument settles it: the format's code2check target is the part slice 6 replaces, so adding it now would be redone; add docs/index.md now (pointing at wiki/index.md) and the rest in slice 6, when the template installs lockstep.

nodes.label: Q19: Who runs the plan check
nodes.explain: Slice 5 merged (#832) and kept both copies of the plan and acceptance checks, with the same checks (wiki/lockstep.md:45): does Company Planning's adoption gate (method_conformance adopt) now call `lockstep plan check`, or keep its own copy for the Inside Success team? Settled by: An argument settles it: the design's reason for the slice is one definition of the format, which a kept copy defeats; the open fact is whether Inside Success repositories can install lockstep (Q2). Pointing the adoption gate at `lockstep plan check` is a change in the Company Planning plugin, not in this repository.

nodes.label: Q21: Three feedback jobs switched off
nodes.explain: Three of the feedback loop's five jobs (weekly analysis, effect counter, fix owner) have been switched off since about 2026-10-12, with no recorded reason; only the collector and the labels job run. Turn them back on? Recommendation: Inspect collector reliability (Q29), then restore one complete correction-to-verified-fix path before broad autonomous analysis. Do not enable jobs as part of a documentation repair. Default: They stay off; the collector and labels job keep running nightly.
